item.title: Traffic congestion caused by Cheltenham to London FlixBus at 1400 on 23 July, 23rd July
item.description:
The FlixBus service from Cheltenham to London via Cirencester was using the road from the A435 to the A417 past The Green Dragon pub and through Elkstone. Doubtless this was to avoid congestion on the A417 at Birdlip but is totally unacceptable. At least 20 vehicles in both directions were caught up and unable to move. It required some very skilful manoeuvring by the bus driver and a lot of reversing vehicles back up to The Green Dragon. This very minor road has become a bit of a rat run but no way should a large bus be on it.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Elkstone, Cotswold
Report on FixMyStreet
